> 文侯曰：「然則夫子何故未嘗稱之？」子方曰：「其為人也真。」

The Marquis presses him: your teacher, why have you never praised him? And 田子方 answers with one character: 真.

## 真 is not sincerity

真 in this chapter is 未經文飾的本然 — the unadorned, the state before the finishing coat.

It is not a virtue of the will. It is the absence of a produced surface. Which is why the chapter places it opposite 迹 — the footprint, the record, the tradition of what was done before.

## 人貌而天虛

The received text reads 人貌而天虛. Some editors move one character down and read 虛緣而葆真. The book does not adopt the emendation, and states why: on either reading the sentence says the same thing — the outside is a person, the inside is empty.

Empty, therefore able to hold. That is the root of 清而容物 later in the chapter: clarity is not purity; it is capacity.

## 葆真: 葆 is to guard

葆: to keep, to preserve. What is guarded is not a possession but a state that erodes by itself if left unguarded.

## 儻然 and the silence of the marquis

儻然: at a loss, abstracted. 文侯 listens and does not speak for the whole day.

This is the first person in the chapter to be hit, and the text records the hit as silence, not as agreement. Then he says what he had been studying is 土梗 — clay puppets. Not "wrong ideas." Puppets: made things.

## 目擊而道存

目擊: eyes meet. 道存: the way is simply there.

Four characters, and the pivot of the chapter. Nothing was said. Nothing was transmitted. The two looked at each other and the thing was present.

Note what this does to every pedagogy built on content: the content can be perfect and the thing still absent, because the thing is not carried in content.

## 交一臂而失之

To pass within one arm's length and lose it.

孔子 says of himself: 吾服女也甚忘 — even what I did with you, I am already forgetting. 日徂: I too am drifting forward day by day.

The "one arm" is the whole point. Not a great distance. The distance of a hand.

## 唐肆: an empty market

唐 reads 空; 肆 is the market. 求馬於唐肆 — looking for a horse in a market that has closed.

The image is for method: the place where the thing used to be available is now simply a place. To keep going there is not devotion; it is a mistake about what kind of place it is now.

## The test

Name one person you learned from — a teacher, a dead author, a former version of yourself. Then ask the 目擊 question: what passed between you that was never written down? If you can name it, you have found the part that cannot be handed on, and the part every method silently assumes was the whole.
